externalFailure.observed: React foreign/self/sibling/family rejection case expected scrollTop 50, received 300

measured: The four invalid requests synchronously return rejected/unavailable at offset 50, without writing scrollTop.

Draining that mounting frame before geometry produces a real 0-to-0 write, then all original assertions pass including valid reveal 50-to-70.
limits: Original CI did not collect write stacks. Its exact failing assertion is reproduced by a legal controlled ordering, not a replay of its original scheduler trace.
The observer adds synchronous file I/O and the controlled variants inject RAF order. Natural baseline runs and controlled experiments are distinct.
Full compiler, native-browser geometry, upstream CI/DCO and independent published review were not executed for this local candidate.
The compiler and host source, original pin and lockfile, and original Nightly suite selection were not changed.
